document_review.I001: Visually inspected brief-1.png: all maximum/minimum-flow and layout bullets match extracted passages; 40%, four to five outlets and 5 m confirmed.
document_review.I002: Visually inspected brief-2.png: sizing bullets and all five schedule columns match extraction, including mm x mm and Pa/m.
document_review.I003: Inspected page 2 link annotation and destination; Online Ductular is a sizing reference, not extra hidden assignment text.
document_review.D002:I001: Office preliminary allowance and approximate sensible fraction visible;formula is graphical mathematics and diffuser image remains source evidence,not detailed room load.
document_review.D002:I002: Diffuser examples,dimensioned section and square-face/four-cone/round-neck description visible. The family number in the text differs from the primary brief/catalogue header;do not silently resolve this transcription discrepancy.
document_review.D002:I003: Embedded manufacturer performance table contains neck/flow/pressure/throw/NC and octave data not captured by text extraction. Preserve this graphical table;individual selected-row transcription requires separate checks.
document_review.D002:I004: Characteristic L diagram and prose describe wall distance or half spacing for opposing discharge. Actual layout/jet/installation correspondence remains unverified.
document_review.D002:I005: Historical ASHRAE2005 selection table and worked diffuser example visible. Keep category,room-load domain and ratio conditions distinct;not evidence of actual room load or universal category mapping.
document_review.D002:I006: Return grille guidance and supply duct layout considerations visible. This is reference material;do not add return-system deliverables beyond the primary brief without a scope decision.
document_review.D002:I007: Low/medium/high pressure velocity tables,pressure-gradient guidance and equivalent-diameter equation visible. Preserve headings,units and source conditions;numeric implementation has separate QA.
document_review.D002:I008: Aspect-ratio table,friction/fitting/critical-path procedures and example equipment drops visible. Example drops are not equipment ratings or measured project facts;assignment scope needs separate interpretation.
document_review.D002:I009: Friction chart is graphical,not blank;axes,diameter/velocity families and stated air-density/roughness/handbook edition visible. Text extraction does not supply chart readings.
document_review.D002:I010: Graphical conical/rectangular fitting schematics and coefficient tables visible. Geometry classes,ratios and reference velocity matter;no blanket coefficient transcription or application accepted.
document_review.D002:I011: Graphical diverging wye/tee coefficient tables and schematics visible despite near-empty extracted text. Signed entries and geometry/flow ratios remain source data requiring individual applicability/transcription review.

requirements.quote:
Students should form groups of up to five members, with each group tasked with designing 
the air conditioning layout for an open-plan office on a typical floor. The architectural layout 
plan for this floor is provided. It is assumed that a variable air volume (VAV) system will be 
utilized in the design.
requirements.acceptance: Pending interpretation: cover the complete source passage, split requirements and establish actual deliverables and verification before execution.

requirements.quote: Each group is required to complete the following tasks.
requirements.acceptance: Pending interpretation: cover the complete source passage, split requirements and establish actual deliverables and verification before execution.

requirements.quote: 1. Space air diffusion design for maximum load condition
requirements.acceptance: Pending interpretation: cover the complete source passage, split requirements and establish actual deliverables and verification before execution.

requirements.quote:
• Calculate the cooling load of the open plan office using rule of thumb. 
• Determine the total supply air flow rate of the office. 
• Distribute supply air diffusers on the layout plan. 
• Calculate the supply air flow rate of each diffuser. 
• Find out the characteristic room length, L. 
• Refer to the performance data of KRUEGER “Louvered Face Diffusers 1400, 51400 
Series 4-cone”, and select a suitable type of diffuser. 
• From the diffuser performance data, find the corresponding T0.25. 
• Calculate T0.25 / L. 
• Check if it meets the ASHRAE ADPI requirement.
requirements.acceptance: Pending interpretation: cover the complete source passage, split requirements and establish actual deliverables and verification before execution.

requirements.quote: 2. Space air diffusion design for minimum load condition
requirements.acceptance: Pending interpretation: cover the complete source passage, split requirements and establish actual deliverables and verification before execution.

requirements.quote:
• Calculate the supply air flow rate of each diffuser with a minimum turn down ratio of 
40%. 
• From the diffuser performance data, find the corresponding T0.25. 
• Calculate T0.25 / L. 
• Check if it meets the ASHRAE ADPI requirement.
requirements.acceptance: Pending interpretation: cover the complete source passage, split requirements and establish actual deliverables and verification before execution.

requirements.quote: 3. Single-line diagram of AC layout plan
requirements.acceptance: Pending interpretation: cover the complete source passage, split requirements and establish actual deliverables and verification before execution.

requirements.quote:
• Use single lines to sketch the air duct layout for distribution of supply air to all supply 
air diffusers in the office. 
• Use VAV boxes with four to five outlets, but limit the flexible duct length (from the 
VAV box to the diffuser) to be within 5 m. 
• Use straight ductwork as far as possible. 
• Minimize bends and turns. 
• Plan branch ducts to extend from the main trunk to distribute air evenly throughout 
the space.
requirements.acceptance: Pending interpretation: cover the complete source passage, split requirements and establish actual deliverables and verification before execution.
Pending interpretation: cover the complete source passage, split requirements and establish actual deliverables and verification before execution.

requirements.quote:
• Determine the size of the main air ducts and each section of the branch air ducts.  
• The air duct size should satisfy the requirements of maximum air velocity and 
limiting air-pressure drops. 
• Use the Friction Chart in ASHRAE Fundamentals or Online Ductular.  
• The maximum aspect ratio of rectangular air duct is preferred to be 4:1. 
• Label each section of the air duct and tabulate the air duct sizing calculation in a table. 
• The following table for air duct sizing is suggested for your use.
